plugin.name: Midnight Club LA Remix PPSSPP Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Follow the emulator display aspect automatically, or force a width:height ratio. Restart the emulated game after changing this option.
HUDScale.description: Scale race HUD around screen-edge anchors; menus keep their original size. Restart the emulated game after changing this option.
DualAnalogPatch.description: Use the right stick to turn the chase camera; D-pad look controls keep their original behavior. Restart the emulated game after changing this option.
FixHUD.description: Keep HUD elements at screen edges and center menus and movies with their original proportions. Restart the emulated game after changing this option.
